Card Q&A.q: I have a Digimon with BT22-007 [Mother Eater] in its digivolution cards in the breeding area. When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by my effects, can I first use BT22-007 [Mother Eater]'s inherited effect to place this card in digivolution cards, then activate this card's [All Turns] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's play cost 6 or lower Digimon or Tamers to the bottom of the deck. For each of your [Mother Eater]'s digivolution cards in the breeding area, add 1 to this effect's play cost maximum.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 [Eater] trait Digimon card from your hand without paying the cost.
[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest play cost Digimon.
